title: Part 2: Never grip the steering wheel like this (Part 2)
hook: Part 2! Stop crossing your arms turning.

script.narration: Part 2! Stop crossing your arms turning. The hand-over-hand technique is actually dangerous during airbag deployment.
script.visual_search: driver hands on steering wheel turning

script.narration: If the airbag fires while your arms are crossed, the force can push your own hands into your face.
script.visual_search: car interior steering wheel airbag test

script.narration: Always use the push-pull steering method to keep your hands on the wheel without crossing them over.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you use the push-pull method? Comment yes or no, so stop crossing your arms turning.

description: In this second part of our steering safety series, we explain why crossing your arms is a major safety risk. Learn the proper push-pull steering technique to stay safe on the road.
why_it_will_work: Continuing a series creates recurring viewership, and this addresses a very common mistake new drivers make, matching the high performance of my previous steering safety content.
